title: HQ's menu icons are copied from a free icon set without the credit line its licence asks for
what: The menu and bottom-bar icons in HQ (bell, phone, speech bubble, pulse line, bin and others) are the same drawings as the free Feather and Lucide icon sets, path for path. Those sets are free to use, but their licences (MIT and ISC) ask that their short copyright notice travels with every copy. HQ ships no such notice anywhere.
expected: Either a one-line credit for the icon set kept with HQ (for example a licences note in the HQ folder or a comment beside the icons), or icons drawn by MettleUp.
who: MettleUp (legal tidiness only; nobody outside sees HQ)
fix_line: Add the icon set's one-line licence notice next to the icons

items.reason: HQ is a private web app (no store listing, noindex), so Play target API, billing, data safety and Wear rules do not reach it. Browser pop-ups are asked only after a tap on Turn on alerts. WhatsApp is copy-and-send by hand, no automated sending. No ads or health claims. Gym owners paying MettleUp by UPI and paid AI packs are only recorded here; whether the admin app may take that money outside Google Play belongs to the panel area.
HQ is not an App Store app; on iPhone it is only added to the home screen from Safari (install hint), so no App Store rules apply.

Fonts are the device's own (no outside fonts). The alert sound is made by code, not a sound file. Logo is MettleUp's own drawing; whether the name and logo are registered could not be seen from code. No pictures, clips, music, voices or libraries ship in HQ. Icons copied from a free set without its credit line.
